evidence.quoted_text:
"manager_restarted": (
            (((manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager") or {})
             .get("pid") or 0) > 0
            and (((manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                 .get("pid") or 0) > 0
            and (manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("pid")
            != (manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("pid")
            and bool(((manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                     .get("invocation_id"))
            and bool(((manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                     .get("invocation_id"))
            and (manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("invocation_id")
            != (manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("invocation_id")),
evidence.reason: The current `manager_restarted` check only verifies nonempty positive PIDs and changed invocation IDs. A guest reboot also changes both, so the check can pass without a manager-only restart; the separate reboot check can still be satisfied afterward. Requiring nonempty equal boot IDs on both sides is the smallest compatible correctness fix for the check's intended meaning and does not add a new contract requirement.
